confidence_notes: Food and beer estimates use [Numbeo's Muscat index](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Muscat), including its June snapshot. Cocktail and wine estimates use their relationship to beer and [local bar price ranges](https://thediscreetgentleman.com/countries/oman/muscat/al-khuwair); prices vary by venue. July accommodation estimates are holistic, with particularly high uncertainty around registered hostel availability.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Gulf capital cities, adjusted for Muscat's relatively inexpensive local restaurants, costly licensed drinks, limited hostel supply and quieter summer demand.
